hypotheses.justification: Let C = (mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a)ᶜ, which is measurable by measurableSet_mutuallySingularSetSlice. The existing proof applied to every measurable t ∩ C shows that (withDensity η (rnDeriv κ η) a).restrict C = (κ a).restrict C, by measure extensionality and Measure.restrict_apply. Evaluate this equality on arbitrary s ⊆ C and use Measure.restrict_eq_self on both sides. Thus s need not be measurable; the argument also covers empty sets and zero kernels.
